images.title: W1.1 Açılış sayfası — kapalı zarf
images.base_prompt: Design a luxury mobile wedding website screen, page 1 of 5: the envelope landing page. Full-bleed portrait phone screen layout — no phone hardware, no status bar, no browser bar. Background: sunlit warm white plaster wall texture fading to a soft sky blue at the bottom (#F7F4EC to #DCE6F2), gentle dappled leaf shadows at the edges, empty center, with lemon branches with ripe yellow lemons, white lemon blossoms and glossy green leaves, fresh watercolor framing the top-left and bottom-right corners and a few small floating accents (a whole ripe lemon with one glossy leaf, a white lemon blossom, a glossy green lemon leaf). Centered slightly below the middle: a crisp bright-white watercolor-paper envelope, about 5:4 wider than tall, with a pointed V flap whose edge is gently scalloped and traced with a thin hand-painted cobalt blue line, closed, with a single small glossy lemon with two leaves and a short sprig of white lemon blossom, tied together with a thin cobalt blue ribbon in a little bow — tucked onto the tip of the V flap. Above it, typography in a breezy flowing script for the names and an elegant high-contrast Didone serif: a small spaced line "YOU ARE INVITED" and the names "Isabella & Marco" large; below the white envelope a small spaced line "TAP TO OPEN". All decor in soft watercolor style. Premium luxury wedding stationery quality, real paper and material textures, soft natural light from the top-left, refined, rich and airy.
